target: positive presynaptic sign to ALLN positive postsynaptic sign (192 model eLNs)

analysis.reference: each population mean during final 500ms of preceding odor
analysis.half_time: first post-OFF <=50% reference sustained for at least 20ms; report null if reference <1Hz
analysis.silence_time: first <=1Hz sustained for at least 100ms; report null if reference <1Hz
analysis.limits: 1ms sampling, 10ms causal filter and population-averaged thresholds; temporal order alone does not prove causation

unchanged: original refractory handling; no threshold adaptation; original 50ms endTick; no odor-OFF reset
normalization: first spike amplitude unchanged; resource R recovers toward 1, release scales jump by R, then R *= (1-U)
parameters: engineering hypotheses, not fly-eLN physiological fits
